newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Tecnimont wins orders for 600 bln lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Tecnimont wins orders for 600 bln lire.

text.p: Tecnimont, the plant engineering offshoot of Montedison, said it landed orders worth a total of 600 billion lire for the construction of industrial installations in Saudi Arabia and Chile.

Tecnimont said in a statement it will supply two fertiliser plants in Saudi Arabia to the Saudi Arabian Fertiliser Company (SAFCO), part of the Saudi Basic Industries Corporation, in a deal worth $300 million.
The plants, with annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes of ammonia and 600,000 tonnes of urea, will be built in the Gulf city of Al Jubail.
Tecnimont also said it had signed a turnkey deal with Petroquim, a joint Chilean-Brazilian entity, for the supply of a 100,000 tonne capacity polypropylene plant to be sited in Concepcion, Chile.
The plant would yse Spheripol technology developed by Montell, a joint venture between Montedison and Shell which is a world leader in polypropylene production.
Tecnimont gave no exact value for the Petroquim contract.
